visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair in pigtails, wearing a white one-piece swimsuit with orange fruit patterns, stands indoors next to a large glass door. Another young girl in a pink swimsuit with heart patterns enters the frame from the left. The background is a bright, modern living space with a large window showing a green lawn. (2) The setting shifts to an outdoor garden during the daytime. A circular watermelon-themed inflatable splash pad is spraying multiple jets of water into the air. The girls step onto the pad, their faces showing excitement. An adult female in a black t-shirt stands nearby on the grass. (3) The girl in the orange swimsuit is seen sitting and splashing in the center of the water jets, her hair is now wet and slicked down. The lighting is bright natural sunlight. She smiles and looks towards the camera. (4) The girl lies down on her stomach inside the shallow water of the splash pad, kicking her feet happily. (5) The girl walks away from the water towards a shaded porch area. Her pigtails are soaked. An adult reaches out to dry her with a blue and white towel featuring dinosaur illustrations. (6) The video concludes with a static pink screen featuring a small cartoon illustration of a girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
